lessons.title: Academic Genres & Systematic Reviews
lessons.teacher_notes: Focus on academic publication genres, literature synthesis, and lexical bundles ('It is widely acknowledged that...').

lessons.title: Advanced Hedging & Epistemic Stance
grammar: Past modal hedging (would seem to indicate)
lessons.teacher_notes: Master hedging claims in research publications to avoid overgeneralization.

lessons.title: Research Ethics & Statistical Data Analysis
lessons.teacher_notes: Examine research ethics, consent protocols, statistical power, regression analysis, and outlier detection.

lessons.title: Litigation, Contracts & Constitutional Law
lessons.teacher_notes: Deconstruct criminal indictments, civil tort liability, contractual indemnity, and constitutional law.

lessons.title: Theme/Rheme Alignment & Inversion
grammar: Syntactic fronting and negative adverb inversion
lessons.teacher_notes: Optimize legal and academic prose flow placing known information in Theme and new heavy clauses at Rheme.

lessons.title: Macroeconomics & Financial Contagion
lessons.teacher_notes: Debate monetary policy interventions, behavioural nudge theory, portfolio diversification, and systemic financial risk.

lessons.title: Corporate Governance & Disruptive Innovation
lessons.teacher_notes: Analyze executive leadership standards, performance appraisals, change management, and disruptive business scaling.

lessons.title: Cohesion, Ellipsis & Substitution
lessons.teacher_notes: Utilize advanced connectors and formal substitution ('the former vs the latter') to ensure tight cohesive flow.

lessons.title: Generative AI, Bioethics & Quantum Computing
lessons.teacher_notes: Explore bioethical research limits, generative AI architecture, zero-trust cloud security, and quantum encryption.

lessons.title: Investigative Press & Editorial Independence
lessons.teacher_notes: Examine editorial independence, whistleblowing safeguards, and investigating corporate corruption.

lessons.title: Periodic & Balanced Sentence Cadence
lessons.teacher_notes: Craft periodic sentences for dramatic impact and balanced parallel structures for rhetorical speeches.

lessons.title: Epistemological Inquiry & Cognitive Dissonance
lessons.teacher_notes: Discuss epistemological bounds of knowledge, metaphysical determinism, confirmation bias, and cognitive restructuring.

lessons.title: Diplomacy, Soft Power & Circular Economy
lessons.teacher_notes: Evaluate soft power diplomacy, multilateral treaties, territorial integrity, and circular economic models.

lessons.title: Executive Writing Genres & Proposals
lessons.teacher_notes: Write high-level policy briefs, feasibility reports, executive proposals, and white papers.

lessons.title: Public Speaking Rhetoric & Q&A Under Pressure
lessons.teacher_notes: Master classical rhetorical figures, thought group chunking, and handling adversarial Q&A sessions under pressure.
